subject: general
question: On 3 August 2021, ______ became India's 69th Grandmaster of Chess at the Biel Masters Open.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harshit Raja.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Harshit Raja**, a 20-year-old chess player from Pune, Maharashtra, has become **India's 69th Grandmaster of Chess.**
 
• He achieved the feat of becoming the GM at** Biel Masters Open 2021** where he drew his game** against Dennis Wagner** to get his final GM norm with one round to spare.
 
• He won silver in U-13 National Chess Championship in Jamshedpur in 2014 and gold in the SGFI Nationals held in Tamil Nadu the same year.
 
• He represented India in World Youth Chess Championship U-14 in Greece in 2015.

 [IMAGE: https://cbin.b-cdn.net/img/HA/Harshit_PVAPN_1000x750.jpeg] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Federation Internationale des Echecs-FIDE** is the highest authority of chess.
 
• It is also known as the **"World Chess Federation"**.
 
• FIDE was founded on 20 July 1924.
 
• Chess players are awarded **Grandmaster (GM)** degrees by the World Chess Federation (FIDE).
 
• This is the **highest book a chess player can get.**
 
• India's First grandmaster - **Viswanathan Anand**
 
• India's First woman grandmaster - **Subbaraman Vijayalakshmi**
 
• **By July 2020, 65 Indian chess players had won the Grand Master title.**
